page.overview:
Who is Travanchet?

Travanchet is an Ascian antagonist in Final Fantasy XIV. He lacks a shadow. It is likely that "Travanchet" was a disguise or pseudonym, as "Travanchet" is not a member of the Convocation of Fourteen, though it is unclear which Ascian would have assumed this identity.

His first appearance is right at the initial quest from Limsa Lominsa's main storyline, talking with Emerick. He is shown to be a very skilled mage, and has connections with the Sahagin attacking Lominsan ships. He is later seen leading the sahagin attack against the Knights of The Barracuda Fleet.

At the end of the third quest, he steals the seal rock "key" from Sthalmann and Y'shtola using telekinetic powers before turning into shadows soon after.

Though he does not reappear in person, he shows up in a flashback from Mide revealing that he was the one who instigated the original summoning of the primal Alexander. In addition, he tricked Mide into placing a magic horn he stole from Y'shtola into the primal's core, promising her that this ritual would cause her deepest desires to come true.
